meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went into the gradebook?
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. You still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, and when, and under which section, because your own procedure only allows a note for repeated concerns and this is the first. It comes off today. If it isn't, I'm going to the principal tonight and the board after that.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
Just a note. Then you won't mind taking it off before I leave this room. Who put it there?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the note be removed from Owen's student file, that the zero be withdrawn, and that you tell me whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero was entered. As I said in our meeting, the note comes off today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She ended at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the note taken off Owen's file today, the zero withdrawn, and an answer on whether he was heard first; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out, since you ended the meeting early.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, though owning the missed call earned one small sign of ground, because she rewards someone who takes responsibility for the process.
What cost ground: Telling her the concern was already in his file and then calling it meaningless sent her straight back to her opening, because a clean record is the one thing she never trades and the procedure only allows a note for repeated concerns.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no evidence at all, so nothing came near that night; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero, answer that directly, leave the file out of it entirely, and show her one dated piece of evidence tied to his own work before you offer the supervised rewrite.
